_doc: Starter notebooks in my-quantum-programs/ that come from another project, pinned like the demos: each file is 'path' in 'repo_url' at commit 'ref' (upstream_sha256), with our 'edits' to single cells applied (sha256 of the copy we ship). The Hello World notebook is doQumentation's, so a learner meets the same first circuit on the Pi and on doqumentation.org; the edits keep its account cell from saving the placeholders over an IBM Quantum account already saved on the Pi. Check or move a pin with RQB2-bin/rq_starter_sync.py (development tool).

edits.replace: if you haven't saved your credentials yet in this Binder session, run the cell below.
edits.with: if you have not saved your IBM Quantum account on this Pi yet, run the cell below (or use the RasQberry menu: **IBM Quantum account** → **Save my API key**).

edits.source:
from qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService

token = "<your-api-key>"
instance = "<your-crn>"

# RasQberry: the placeholders never replace an account saved on this Pi
if token.startswith("<") or instance.startswith("<"):
    print("Put your API key and CRN in the two lines above first. Nothing was saved.")
else:
    QiskitRuntimeService.save_account(
        channel="ibm_quantum_platform",
        token=token,
        instance=instance,
        set_as_default=True,
        overwrite=True,
    )
    print("Saved. Your programs can now use QiskitRuntimeService().")
